data.observations: All eight fixed cells completed with ACCEPT: both controls and both candidates on substitution and KAM-mode-3. The KAM delta candidate recorded delta=1 while its control recorded 0; the KAM iota candidate recorded iota=1 while its control recorded 0. Every cell retained unchanged input bytes, exit 0, complete cleanup, one positive RSS sample and no timeout, memory breach or monitor error. Candidate verdicts matched across profiles in both families, so no signal was observed in this exact sample.
data.limitations: This is an E0 screen over one constructed pair per family and two profiles sharing one implementation; it is not a conformance, correctness, soundness or general no-difference claim. The substitution summary does not separately expose recursor-iota demand, so iota demand is established only by the KAM counter and source derivation. The first sandbox attempt failed before child launch because /bin/ps was denied; the initial host-retry wrapper then failed before child launch on an incorrect literal count. Both failures are preserved and repaired without changing scientific fixtures, profiles or limits.
data.decision: Close the campaign as NO_SIGNAL and do not create an E1 confirmation proposal. Retain the fixtures and supervised raw evidence as exploratory material only. At campaign handoff select the highest-value feasible separate successor and do not start it.
data.cost: Eight completed LazyLean cells used 0.201 seconds summed child wall time, eight total positive RSS samples and at most 1,343,488 observed RSS bytes per process group. The successful host command took 3.6 seconds including supervisor preflights. One sandbox monitor preflight and one retry-wrapper check failed before any child launch. Deterministic command/model-token cost and manual analysis time are unavailable; no dollar estimate is inferred.
